newsitem.title: USA: U.S. university up for sale.
newsitem.headline: U.S. university up for sale.

text.p: Huron University is up for sale, a university spokeswoman said Wednesday.
But she declined to give the asking price for the school, which has a total enrollment of around 2,000 students.

The university's Japanese owner, Dr. Chikara Higashi, had signed a letter of intent to sell the Huron campus and two other sites after an association of area schools threatened to withdraw Huron's academic accreditation in December because of problems with the school's financial records, the spokeswoman said.
She said the school has exchanged hands three times since 1983.
